endorsements.name: Jin Chen
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-2003
endorsements.description: An external control of filename vulnerability in the command processing of PAN-OS allows an authenticated administrator to delete arbitrary system files affecting the integrity of the system or causing denial of service to all PAN-OS services. This issue affects: All versions of PAN-OS 7.1 and 8.0; PAN-OS 8.1 versions before 8.1.14; PAN-OS 9.0 versions before 9.0.7; PAN-OS 9.1 versions before 9.1.1.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.5)

endorsements.name: Jin Chen
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-2009
endorsements.description: An external control of filename vulnerability in the SD WAN component of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Panorama allows an authenticated administrator to send a request that results in the creation and write of an arbitrary file on all firewalls managed by the Panorama. In some cases this results in arbitrary code execution with root permissions. This issue affects: All versions of PAN-OS 7.1; PAN-OS 8.1 versions earlier than 8.1.14; PAN-OS 9.0 versions earlier than 9.0.7.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.2)

endorsements.label: CVE-2020-2030
endorsements.description: An OS Command Injection vulnerability in the PAN-OS management interface that allows authenticated administrators to execute arbitrary OS commands with root privileges. endorsements.name: Jin Chen
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-2031
endorsements.description: An integer underflow vulnerability in the dnsproxyd component of the PAN-OS management interface allows authenticated administrators to issue a command from the command line interface that causes the component to stop responding. Repeated attempts to send this request result in denial of service to all PAN-OS services by restarting the device and putting it into maintenance mode. This issue impacts: PAN-OS 9.1 versions earlier than PAN-OS 9.1.3. This issue does not impact PAN-OS 8.1, PAN-OS 9.0, or Prisma Access services.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.9)
